thread:
alana-sales: Micah from CipherHealth says their Dedicated POC pool never reaches READY. They get an AZ capacity error and also some 429s from the reserved API. Can infra + eng help triage?

infra-bot: create-pool pc-2042 failed status=ERROR reason=InsufficientCapacity: no capacity for V100-32GB in us-east-1a

micah-client: yes — we see the InsufficientCapacity and then when we retry we hit "429 Too Many Requests" on /v1/dedicated/pools. Retries are automated from our side but still failing.

jess-eng: can you share the pool request payload? curious about AZ pinning and size.

alana-sales: they shared this: 
```json
{
  "region": "us-east-1",
  "azAffinity": ["us-east-1a"],
  "gpuType": "V100-32GB",
  "count": 6,
  "commitMonths": 6,
  "billing": "reserved"
}
```

tom-infra: two separate things: (1) locking to us-east-1a for V100s is failing — that AZ has 0 spare V100 capacity today. (2) the 429s are our rate limiter triggering because the client retrier is aggressive. Short-term: remove azAffinity or allow multiple AZs; reduce count to 2-3 to get a baseline pool; add exponential backoff on retries. I'll also submit a capacity increase request to the cloud provider and link it here.

olivia-cs: Micah — is it okay if we put the POC in us-east-1b/c for the trial? Also for security: we need their KMS ARN and an S3 audit destination. We can enable customer-managed keys and bucket streaming once they provide values.

micah-client: using 1b/1c for POC is fine. We'll share KMS ARN and an S3 path. Pricing note: we asked sales about committed pricing tiers — Alana can you confirm pricing per GPU/month for a 6mo vs 12mo?

alana-sales: I'll put together a quick comparison once we lock region and final GPU count. For now we'll price the smaller interim pool.

jess-eng: making changes to provisioning config: removing azAffinity, enabling regionFallback, setting initial nodes=3 and marking retry-policy exponential with cap 5s. Re-applying pool create.

infra-bot: create-pool pc-2042 attempt=2 status=IN_PROGRESS

infra-bot: create-pool pc-2042 status=READY nodes=3 region=us-east-1b shape=V100-32GB

micah-client: pool is up, thanks. We'll run smoke tests and report any perf issues.

olivia-cs: I'll prepare the security checklist and a short doc on how to provide the KMS ARN + S3 dest via our secure intake. Also drafting an SOW addendum to reflect initial reduced commit and a path to scale to 6 once cloud quota is confirmed.

tom-infra: filing cloud provider capacity ticket CF-33127 and internal tracking CR-7790. Will update when provider confirms additional V100 availability in us-east-1a.

jess-eng: note for runbook: when InsufficientCapacity occurs, try regionFallback and avoid simultaneous high-frequency client retries — the combination spikes our token-based rate limiter and causes 429s. Example log: 
```
ERROR: InsufficientCapacity - Requested 6 V100-32GB in us-east-1a
ClientRetryBurst: 15 within 25s -> RateLimiter: 429
```

alana-sales: great work team. Micah, I'll DM the pricing comparison and SOW draft. Follow-ups: cloud ticket CF-33127, internal CR-7790. :thumbsup:
